notes: The L3 'three separate groups' warning is not a real problem for this set: 30105 is a polybag that genuinely builds three independent models, namely the mailbox (page 1, steps 1-3), the flower display stand (steps 1-8), and the Stephanie mini-doll holding a letter. The booklet's final picture shows them standing side by side, and no step joins them. The graph therefore keeps three groups on purpose.

Only the two instruction pages were provided (no inventory pages), so Element IDs are not known. Part types are best-guess matches from the catalogue (colour in props); three new types were added for pieces with no obvious match.

Stand steps 1-4 are hard to read in the pictures: the white base (2x4 brick plus two 1x4 bricks), black grille, black 2x2 plate, white bottles with brown tops are inferred. A white plate on top of the bottles in step 4 was not modelled separately.

The step-7 red support piece is modelled as a red 2x2 brick sitting on studs (the picture's pin is not modelled). Items on the stand are spread over separate studs so no stud is used twice; the plate under the roof is a lego-3020 2x4 so both bottle tops get their own anti-stud.

The flower stem has one stud, so it carries one flower; the other two flowers in step 5 are placed on free studs of a 1x4 brick next to it (exact positions are approximate). The red slope/board seen in step 5 is inferred.
Step 7 sub-assembly (white 2x4 plate, red support brick, two pink roof slopes, white 1x1 brick with hole) rests on the brown bottle tops; step 8 adds two red heart halves on the roof.
The mailbox roof is shown in step 3 with no parts box; modelled as a pink 2x2 slope on the red body. The letter is held in Stephanie's hand (contact only).
